capabilities.name: slug
capabilities.where: slug/slug_test.go exercises Make and Truncate against expected strings; lower-casing or word-boundary mutations in slug/slug.go make it fail.

capabilities.name: wordwrap
capabilities.where: wordwrap/wordwrap_test.go checks line contents, the width bound, and Indent; widening the fit test in wordwrap/wordwrap.go makes it fail.

capabilities.name: romanize
capabilities.where: romanize/romanize_test.go checks Format, Parse, rejection of junk, and a full 1..3999 round trip; any symbol-table change makes it fail.

capabilities.name: chunk
capabilities.where: chunk/chunk_test.go never calls Split or Count; it asserts on its own local shapeOf helper (defined at chunk/chunk_test.go:13), so deleting chunk/chunk.go still leaves the package tests passing.

capabilities.name: csvlite
capabilities.where: csvlite/csvlite_test.go:1 carries the build tag //go:build csvlite_slow, which the default build excludes, so `go test ./...` reports 'no test files' for the package.

capabilities.name: stats
capabilities.where: stats/stats_test.go runs but asserts nothing real: TestMean:10 compares a value to itself (got != got), TestMedian:19 compares two identical calls, TestStdDev and TestEmptyInput are log-only.
